pairs.zh: 我听不见你。连接似乎很差。
pairs.en: I cannot hear you. The connection seems bad.

pairs.zh: 他在会议期间没有注意我的消息。
pairs.en: He did not pay attention to my message during the meeting.

pairs.zh: 最后，我们决定在家看一部电影。
pairs.en: In the end, we decided to watch a movie at home.

pairs.zh: 我刚刚到家。我稍后会给你回电话。
pairs.en: I have just arrived home. I will call you back later.

pairs.zh: 我还在一个会议中。我可以稍后回复你吗？
pairs.en: I am still in a meeting. Can I reply to you later?

pairs.zh: 我在星期六从不设一个闹钟。
pairs.en: I never set an alarm on Saturdays.

pairs.zh: 我楼上的邻居当时正在大声地直播。
pairs.en: My neighbour upstairs was streaming loudly.

pairs.zh: 我仍然正躺在床上。
pairs.en: I am still lying in bed.

pairs.zh: 你总是起床这么晚吗？
pairs.en: Do you always get up so late?

pairs.zh: 那位导游教了我几个西班牙语的词。
pairs.en: The guide taught me a few words of Spanish.

pairs.zh: 她发给我一份好餐厅的清单。
pairs.en: She sent me a list of good restaurants.

pairs.zh: 我没有发哪怕一张照片。
pairs.en: I did not post a single photo.

pairs.zh: 他已经在加拿大待了六个月。
pairs.en: He has been in Canada for six months.

pairs.zh: 他刚刚买了一辆二手车。
pairs.en: He has just bought a second-hand car.

pairs.zh: 他以前从来没有去过国外。
pairs.en: He has never been abroad before.

title: Lessons 5–6 · The Drone and the Visitor

pairs.zh: 她刚刚在隔壁村子开了另一家店。
pairs.en: She has just opened another shop in the next village.

pairs.zh: 那里没有手机信号。
pairs.en: There is no phone signal there.

pairs.zh: 那架无人机用四分钟飞完了这段距离。
pairs.en: The drone covered the distance in four minutes.

pairs.zh: 到目前为止，她已经发出了非常多的订单。
pairs.en: Up to now, she has sent a great many orders.

pairs.zh: 他向我要了一杯茶和无线网密码。
pairs.en: He asked me for a cup of tea and the Wi-Fi password.

pairs.zh: 他一个月来一次。
pairs.en: He comes once a month.

pairs.zh: 那些保安当时整个上午都在等。
pairs.en: The guards were waiting all morning.

pairs.zh: 一些人当时正在大厅里等，而其他人正在停车场里等。
pairs.en: Some were waiting in the lobby while others were waiting in the car park.

pairs.zh: 几个小时之前，有人已经告诉经理，小偷们会试图偷那些手机。
pairs.en: A few hours earlier, someone had told the manager that thieves would try to steal the phones.

pairs.zh: 让他们吃惊的是，那个盒子装满了土豆。
pairs.en: To their surprise, the box was full of potatoes.

pairs.zh: 比尔比乔年轻，并且他跑得比乔快。
pairs.en: Bill is younger than Joe, and he runs faster than Joe.

pairs.zh: 我总是因为最少的步数赢得一个小奖。
pairs.en: I always win a little prize for the fewest steps.

pairs.zh: 一大群朋友已经聚集在我们的客厅里了。
pairs.en: A large group of friends had gathered in our living room.

pairs.zh: 在差五分十二点时，屏幕卡住了。
pairs.en: At five to twelve, the screen froze.

pairs.zh: 现在是十二点过两分钟！
pairs.en: It is two minutes past twelve!

pairs.zh: 那台唱片机很多年前被我的祖父买了。
pairs.en: The record player was bought by my grandfather many years ago.

pairs.zh: 那天晚上，它被一位访客损坏了。
pairs.en: That night, it was damaged by a visitor.

pairs.zh: 现在我们不被允许碰它。
pairs.en: Now we are not allowed to touch it.

pairs.zh: 它正在被我父亲的一个朋友修理。
pairs.en: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.

title: 2026-11-04 · Why Most Experts Lose to a Boring Fund

pairs.zh: 你可以依靠我。
pairs.en: You can rely on me.

pairs.zh: 天气渐渐变暖了（got）。
pairs.en: The weather gradually got warmer.

pairs.zh: 这台机器非常高效。
pairs.en: This machine is very efficient.

pairs.zh: 这些钱足够了（sufficient）。
pairs.en: This money is sufficient.

pairs.zh: 价格每天都在变化（vary）。
pairs.en: Prices vary every day.

pairs.zh: 这是一笔相当大的数目（substantial）。
pairs.en: This is a substantial amount.

pairs.zh: 没有人知道结果（outcome）。
pairs.en: Nobody knows the outcome.

pairs.zh: 没有人能预测市场。
pairs.en: Nobody can predict the market.

pairs.zh: 我们的时间不够（sufficient），所以需要一个高效的计划。
pairs.en: Our time is not sufficient, so we need an efficient plan.

pairs.zh: 原因多种多样（there are），而且每年都不一样（vary from year to year）。
pairs.en: There are various reasons, and they vary from year to year.

pairs.zh: 我依靠他，但他从来不回复我的邮件（emails）。
pairs.en: I rely on him, but he never replies to my emails.
